WuxGl2IKazkiacKDhCFkFg.zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,今年 1-10 週累計報告約 28,000 例病例,其中,該國東北部贊比西區截至 3/30 累計報告 10,330 例病例,近 1 週報告1,719 例病例。
WuxGl2IKazkiacKDhCFkFg.en: Malaria in Namibia is rising. From week 1 to week 10 this year, about 28,000 cases have been reported cumulatively. In Zambezi Region in the northeast, 10,330 cases were reported cumulatively as of 30 March, and 1,719 cases were reported in the past week.

9jSsUeFt8N-l_8MJs7IOig.zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,今年1-5週累計報告11,327例確診病例,其中,73%為本土病例,27%為境外移入病例,共21例死亡。
9jSsUeFt8N-l_8MJs7IOig.en: Malaria in Namibia is rising. From week 1 to week 5 this year, 11,327 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively; 73% were locally acquired and 27% were imported. A total of 21 deaths have been reported.

wGDwOshPKDyPayVvrNrncA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/12-18期間,環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦3件,cVDPV2新增3國共5件,分別為納米比亞/阿爾及利亞2件、奈及利亞1件。
wGDwOshPKDyPayVvrNrncA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 February, for environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported three samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 newly reported five samples in three countries: two each in Namibia and Algeria, and one in Nigeria.

wmLjrWcS1lgJnWez9fXwAA.zh: 納米比亞東北部卡萬戈區(Kavango East)於11/27廢水檢體中檢出cVDPV2陽性環境樣本1件,為該國自2008年根除小兒麻痺症後首次檢出cVDPV2,目前尚未報告人類感染病例。該分離株與目前在安哥拉流行之cVDPV2株密切相關,顯示跨國傳播風險。
wmLjrWcS1lgJnWez9fXwAA.en: In the Kavango East region in northeastern Namibia, one wastewater environmental sample collected on 27 November tested positive for cVDPV2. This is the first detection of cVDPV2 since Namibia's polio eradication in 2008, and no human infection has been reported. The isolate is closely related to the cVDPV2 strain currently circulating in Angola, indicating a cross-border transmission risk.

4ABG2amxspOD6gY_Xnbilg.zh: 納米比亞11/24報告新增1例死亡病例,病患於18日因疑症狀入院治療,19日死亡,經實驗室確診,該病為嚴重病毒性出血熱,除經由蜱蟲叮咬,亦可能透過牲畜或其血液組織等接觸傳染,迄無疫苗。該國於2016-23年間累計報告7例確診病例,其中4例死亡(CFR:57%)。當局已匡列接觸者,並進行預防措施,呼籲民眾於戶外穿戴防護衣物,以預防感染,處理動物或在屠宰場工作人員應戴手套和防護裝備,並在屠宰前對動物進行至少2週之治療或隔離措施。
4ABG2amxspOD6gY_Xnbilg.en: Namibia reported one new death on 24 November. The patient was admitted for treatment on 18 November with suspected symptoms and died on 19 November; laboratory testing confirmed a serious viral haemorrhagic fever. Besides tick bites, it may also be transmitted through contact with livestock or their blood and tissues, and there is no vaccine. From 2016 to 2023, the country reported 7 confirmed cases, of which 4 died (CFR 57%). Authorities have identified contacts and implemented preventive measures, and urge the public to wear protective clothing outdoors. People who handle animals or work in slaughterhouses should wear gloves and protective equipment, and animals should be treated or quarantined for at least two weeks before slaughter.

Lh2ZKwPV_wjl8ljihdHezA.zh: 辛巴威疫情上升,今年迄今累計126,229例病例,較去年同期31,813例上升296.8%,以該國東北部中馬紹納蘭省49,944例最多,其次為該國東部馬卡蘭省27,398例;今年迄今累計358例死亡(CFR 0.3%),較去年同期59例死亡上升506.8%。非洲南部之波札那、史瓦帝、納米比亞等國疫情亦上升。
Lh2ZKwPV_wjl8ljihdHezA.en: Malaria is rising in Zimbabwe. So far this year, 126,229 cases have been reported, up 296.8% from 31,813 in the same period last year. Mashonaland Central Province in the northeast accounts for the most, with 49,944 cases, followed by Manicaland Province in the east with 27,398 cases. So far this year, 358 deaths have been reported (CFR 0.3%), up 506.8% from 59 deaths in the same period last year. Malaria has also increased in the southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini and Namibia.

35kU8M_bzip_Du9Yd06Y9A.zh: 納米比亞疫情上升,近1週(6/2-8)報告2,475例病例,較前1週增加5%,自去年底迄今累計89,959例病例及146例死亡,以東北部卡蒂馬穆利洛(23,959例病例及19例死亡)疫情較為嚴峻。 韓國疫情更新,今年截至7/14累計259例病例,其中21例為境外移入,低於去年同期(318例),病例主要分布於京畿道。
35kU8M_bzip_Du9Yd06Y9A.en: Malaria is rising in Namibia. In the most recent week (2–8 June), 2,475 cases were reported, up 5% from the previous week. Since late last year, 89,959 cumulative cases and 146 deaths have been reported. The northeastern Katima Mulilo area has the most severe situation, with 23,959 cases and 19 deaths. South Korea's update: as of 14 July this year, 259 cumulative cases have been reported, including 21 imported cases. This is lower than the 318 cases in the same period last year, and cases are mainly in Gyeonggi Province.

qgBXy2g0S-Xn3jZf8f8KCw.zh: 納米比亞疫情更新,自去年底迄3/23累計逾30,000例病例及60餘例死亡,致死率為0.2%,高於去年全年12,000例病例及28例死亡。
qgBXy2g0S-Xn3jZf8f8KCw.en: Namibia update: from late last year to 23 March, more than 30,000 cases and over 60 deaths have been reported cumulatively, a CFR of 0.2%. This is higher than the full-year 2024 total of 12,000 cases and 28 deaths.
